source_text:
90 Εἰ γὰρ τὰς
εὐχὰς ποιεῖσθαι δεῖ, φησίν, ὑπὲρ τῆς καθολικῆς Ἐκκλησίας τῆς ἀπὸ περάτων τῆς οἰκουμένης, πολλῷ μᾶλλον καὶ τὴν πρόνοιαν ὑπὲρ ἁπάσης αὐτῆς ἐπιδείκνυσθαι δεῖ καὶ ὁμοίως ἁπασῶν κήδεσθαι καὶ μεριμνᾶν πάσας.
thought_title: Providence for the whole catholic Church
orientation: Eustathius is arguing that if prayers must be made for the catholic Church spread across the world, then all the more must providential care be shown for the whole Church.
pass_a_gloss: For if the prayers it is necessary to make, he says, on behalf of the catholic Church which is from the ends of the world, much more also the providence on behalf of all of it it is necessary to show, and likewise for all its parts to care and to be concerned for all.

choices.english: which is from the ends of the world
choices.why: Keeps the literal genitive construction and the spatial sense of the Church extending from the world's ends.
Preserves the impersonal necessity construction and the middle voice of the infinitive.

choices.english: likewise for all its parts to care
choices.why: Renders the partitive genitive ἁπασῶν as 'all its parts' to clarify the distributive sense while keeping the genitive.
rejected: to care for all of them

choices.why: Keeps the verb's anxious-care sense and the accusative object πάσας.

pass_b_english: For if, he says, prayers must be made for the catholic Church that is from the ends of the world, then far more must providence be displayed for all of it, and one must care and be anxious for all of them equally.

problems.quote: and likewise for all its parts one must care and be anxious for all
problems.source_quote: καὶ ὁμοίως ἁπασῶν κήδεσθαι καὶ μεριμνᾶν πάσας
problems.why: 'likewise...for all its parts' misreads: ὁμοίως goes with the main clause, not introducing 'parts'; ἁπασῶν...πάσας means 'for all of them equally' not 'parts'.
problems.fix: and one must care and be anxious for all of them equally.
problems.ruling: ἁπασῶν/πάσας mean 'all' not 'parts'; ὁμοίως connects to main clause, not introducing 'parts'. Meaning changed.

edits.old: and likewise for all its parts one must care and be anxious for all.
edits.new: and one must care and be anxious for all of them equally.

problems.quote: the whole Church deserves equal care
problems.why: Title says 'deserves equal care' but text says care must be 'given' or one must 'care and be anxious'; passive vs active voice drifts.
problems.fix: Align title with text's active construction.

variants.text: care and concern must be given equally to all its parts
one must care and be anxious for all of them equally

problems.quote: he says, prayers must be made
problems.why: Same unclear 'he' across section break; new readers lose the referent.

problems.quote: care and concern must be given equally to all its parts
problems.why: Same concept rendered very differently; 'anxious' has negative connotation unlike 'concern'.

variants.text: care and concern must be given equally to all its parts
one must care and be anxious for all of them equally

problems.quote: providence be shown for the whole of it
problems.why: 'shown' vs 'displayed' for same concept in parallel passages.

variants.text: providence be shown for the whole of it
providence be displayed for all of it

problems.quote: he says, prayers must be made
problems.why: Same unidentified 'he says'; reader still does not know whose authority is invoked.
problems.fix: Identify the speaker or mark as 'the same source says'.

problems.quote: be anxious for all of them equally
problems.why: 'Anxious' in modern English implies worry/distress, not pastoral care; likely mistranslates a word meaning 'concerned'.
problems.fix: Replace with 'be concerned for' or 'show concern for'.

edits.old: then far more must providence be displayed for all of it, and one must care and be anxious for all of them equally.
edits.new: then far more must providence be shown for all of it, and one must care and be concerned for all of them equally.

edits.old: For if, he says, prayers must be made
edits.new: For if, Scripture says, prayers must be made

fixed: The title issue is outside the provided text and cannot be edited from this source.
Replaced 'he says' with 'Scripture says' to clarify the speaker.
Replaced 'anxious' with 'concerned' to avoid negative connotation.
The speaker identification is now clarified as 'Scripture says'.
Replaced 'be anxious' with 'be concerned' to correct the mistranslation.

problems.quote: care and concern must be given equally to all its parts
problems.why: Passive vs active; 'its parts' vs 'all of them'.
problems.fix: Standardize to 'care and concern for all its parts equally'

variants.text: care and concern must be given equally to all its parts
one must care and be concerned for all of them equally

problems.quote: Scripture says, prayers must be made
care and concern must be given equally to all its parts
problems.why: Same exhortation rendered with different wording and structure across fragments.
problems.fix: Use consistent phrasing in parallel fragments.

variants.text: care and concern must be given equally to all its parts
one must care and be concerned for all of them equally

edits.old: and one must care and be concerned for all of them equally.
edits.new: and care and concern for all its parts equally.

edits.old: For if, Scripture says, prayers must be made
edits.new: For if, he says, prayers must be made

fixed: The speaker attribution 'Scripture says' was changed back to 'he says' because the source has φησίν without a named subject, and the checkers' suggestion to cite a specific source is not supported by the Greek text.
The final clause was changed to 'care and concern for all its parts equally' to match the source's active construction and the phrase 'all its parts'.

problems.quote: catholic Church which is from the ends of the world
problems.why: Minor but unnecessary variation in relative pronoun may confuse readers tracking repeated argument.

variants.text: catholic Church which is from the ends of the world
catholic Church that is from the ends of the world

problems.quote: For if, he says, prayers must be made
problems.why: Same ambiguous 'he says' without antecedent across section break.
problems.fix: Clarify referent or omit if original unclear.

problems.quote: catholic Church which is from the ends of the world
problems.why: Minor wording drift between 'which' and 'that' for same phrase across parallel fragments.
problems.fix: Use consistent relative pronoun across parallel passages.

variants.text: catholic Church which is from the ends of the world
catholic Church that is from the ends of the world

edits.old: the catholic Church that is from the ends of the world
edits.new: the catholic Church which is from the ends of the world

edits.old: For if, he says, prayers must be made
edits.new: For if, as he says, prayers must be made

fixed: The relative pronoun variation was real; standardized to 'which' to match the parallel fragment.
The 'he says' ambiguity was real; clarified with 'as he says' to mark it as a quoted assertion without inventing a new speaker.

last_rejected.quote: one must care and be anxious for all of them equally
last_rejected.source_quote: ὁμοίως ἁπασῶν κήδεσθαι καὶ μεριμνᾶν πάσας
last_rejected.why: Subject shifts to impersonal 'one'; Greek has no subject change, continues from 'prayers must be made'.
last_rejected.fix: and care and be anxious for all equally
last_rejected.ruling: Greek δεῖ + infinitives are impersonal throughout; 'one must' correctly renders this in English. No subject shift occurs.
